task.subject: A firewall-destination review workflow for the bradygaster/gh-aw-cao repository
task.intent: Assess whether the firewall-destination review workflow activates on new or changed outbound destinations, records bounded review evidence for each eligible destination, surfaces actionable review gaps, and attains its intended value of keeping destination-review demand under control with workflow-scoped gh-aw attainment evidence.
activationConditions: A repository operator enables a standalone firewall-destination review workflow on bradygaster/gh-aw-cao.
A new, removed, or changed outbound destination is observed for that workflow within the dashboard horizon.
A workflow-scoped gh-aw attainment observation for the same workflow is retained in the selected horizon.
requiredEffects: Each eligible destination-review opportunity is represented by bounded firewall evidence tied to one workflow run and one destination decision context.
High-priority or degraded observations remain visible in an actionable review queue until the operator can inspect the evidence and disposition.
The dashboard preserves the workflow-scoped gh-aw attainment metric without normalizing, clamping, or fabricating missing values.
noopConditions: No outbound destination is observed for the workflow in the selected horizon.
The workflow records only stable, already-reviewed destinations with no new drift or evidence gap.
Firewall evidence is unavailable for a run, in which case the workflow must not imply that review demand was cleared.
successConditions: Eligible destination-review demand appears as workflow-scoped review observations over time.
The operator can identify recent workflow executions and inspect the highest-priority destination reviews without leaving the dashboard.
Workflow attainment remains attributable to the synthetic workflow through the preserved gh-aw metric identifier and native ratio values.
uncertainties: A reviewed destination does not by itself prove that policy was changed or that the destination became safe.
A successful run can still leave incomplete evidence or unresolved review demand.
A null attainment observation must remain distinct from a numeric zero because missing evidence is not equivalent to failed attainment.

operationalValue.preservation: Preserve the gh-aw metric identifier, ordered position, native finite ratio values or null, and higher-is-better direction exactly as published for the workflow.

contract.stableOpportunity: One workflow-scoped outbound-destination review opportunity keyed by repository, workflow, destination domain, protocol, and review-state evidence within the selected horizon.
acceptedRepositoryEvidence: Workflow inventory proving the workflow is enabled for the repository.
Firewall observations for the same workflow and repository, including destination decision, drift, review labels, and evidence coverage.
Workflow run provenance linked from the firewall observation that triggered or refreshed the review opportunity.
Workflow-scoped gh-aw attainment observations published for the same workflow under the firewall-review-attainment metric identifier.

directMetric.maturationRule: A run-level attainment observation is considered matured only when the corresponding destination-review opportunity has workflow-linked firewall evidence and the gh-aw metric is published for that workflow run.
directMetric.zeroRule: The direct metric is zero when a matured workflow observation shows unresolved destination-review demand with no attained review outcome for the eligible opportunity set.
directMetric.missingEvidenceRule: The direct metric is null when workflow-linked firewall evidence or the gh-aw attainment publication is missing, incomplete, or unavailable for the opportunity horizon.
